title: Hex20 element (20-node serendipity, 3x3x3 quadrature)
objective: Add the Hex20 serendipity element: 20 nodes (8 corners + 12 edge midpoints, no face or interior nodes), quadratic serendipity shape functions, 3x3x3 = 27 Gauss points.
scope: Derive the 20 serendipity shape functions following the standard recipe (Bathe §4).
implementation_steps: Derive the 20 shape functions for the natural-coordinate (xi, eta, zeta) reference cube.
Enumerate the 3x3x3 Gauss points and weights.
Unit-test partition of unity, quadratic-field exactness, and positive Jacobian on a regular hex.
acceptance_criteria: Partition of unity at all 27 quadrature points.
Jacobian positive on a regular hex.
risks: 27-point quadrature with 20 nodes inflates the JIT budget. Mitigation: check the budget counter explicitly and restructure into sub-functions if it exceeds 512 lines per `@ti.func`.
completion_notes: Added ElementType.HEX20 + hex20 basis/quadrature + hex20_tables.py (20-node serendipity, 3x3x3 = 27 Gauss pts).
Widened ElementIR/ProblemIR supported sets to {hex8, tet4, tet10, hex20}; Hex27+ still rejected with Plan B phase B5 pointer.
Partition-of-unity error at 27 Gauss pts: 1.11e-16 (machine epsilon).
JIT-budget caveat documented (20x27=540 near 512 ceiling; future codegen must split across helpers).
Full fast suite: 1175 passed + 23 skipped + 1 expected TODO fail.
